lines.text: Get out of our way, broke noob!
Look at his cheap bacon hair and dusty jacket. He doesn't even belong here.
At lunch, Leo tried to sit at the empty table, but the three rich kids blocked his tray.
Sit on the floor where you belong, they laughed, as everyone stared.
Leo didn't say a word. He just picked up his tray and walked away.
They had no idea what his family was about to do that very night.
The next morning, the principal called an emergency assembly for the whole school.
Attention students! Our school has officially been bought by a billionaire new owner.
The three bullies smirked, bragging that it had to be one of their rich dads.
Whoever owns this place is kicking that noob out today, they whispered.
Minutes later, the principal's office door swung open, and everyone froze in shock.
Leo walked straight past the bullies, wearing the same blue shirt and bacon hair.
Welcome, sir, the principal bowed, handing Leo the golden deed to the school.
Leo turned to the pale bullies and smiled: Guess I'm not sitting on the floor today.
The same three kids who mocked him dropped to their knees, begging for forgiveness.
Because in life, you never know who the quiet kid really is.
